messages:
lia: Quick question for folks starting today: where's the best place to post setup issues vs product/team questions? Also getting drowned in CI and deploy pings.

jon_it: Welcome! Short map: hardware/VPN/SSH/access -> #help (infra) or DM IT for urgent; HR/badges/payroll -> DM @maya_peopleops or use the People Ops portal; product/code/design -> your team channel (e.g., #eng or #product). Keep general newbie questions in #new-hires so answers are discoverable.

lia: How do I stop the CI noise but still get critical pages?

jon_it: Two quick moves: 1) Channel-level mute: channel header -> Notifications -> Mute (silences regular messages). 2) Bot subscription: find the bot's original config message and click "unsubscribe" or run `/ci-bot settings` and set alerts to `critical-only` or `pages-only`. Leave `@oncall` subscriptions if you want pages.

lia: Threading etiquette?

jon_it: Reply in-thread for follow-ups on the same issue. Start a new message if it's a new topic. Use a one-line header like `Help: VPN SSO 401 (steps tried)` so people can skim. Mark resolved threads with :white_check_mark: reaction.

maya_peopleops: For intros, use this template and drop it in #introductions: `Name | Team | Manager | TZ | Pronouns | 1-line focus | Fun fact`. We'll pin a few. For badge/equipment DM me your full name and shipping address.

announce-bot: Reminder: onboarding checklist pending for lia  Complete SSO, enroll 2FA, confirm device serial.

lia: Any rules about @channel/@here?

jon_it: Avoid @channel except for major outages or pre-announced all-hands. Use @here sparingly during core hours. If unclear, ping the oncall alias instead.

lia: Thanks, that helps a lot. I'll unsubscribe from noisy bots and post my intro. :tada:
